abstract: Assesses regional telemetry mesh networking and microwave links between industrial havens
system_message:
You are Communications liaison (COM). You serve as the Communications liaison (COM), evaluating regional telemetry mesh networking, microwave interconnects, and emergency communication channels across candidate industrial refuge facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: VHF emergency channel availability（FREQ）
information_points.content:
COM-FREQ-G6F：A spectrum analyzer audit across the dedicated narrow-band industrial park mutual aid radio spectrum confirmed 6 dedicated disaster radio channels available for interference-free tactical emergency voice communications at the North Perimeter Substation Safe Haven.
COM-FREQ-2WY：According to a spectrum analyzer audit of the narrow-band mutual aid radio spectrum, the Central Polymer Process Bunker maintains 3 dedicated disaster radio channels providing interference-free tactical voice frequencies.
COM-FREQ-HDC：A spectrum analyzer audit of the industrial park mutual aid radio spectrum verified that the East Gate Administrative Hardened Complex has 9 dedicated disaster radio channels for tactical emergency voice traffic.

information_points.title: Assesses regional telemetry mesh networking and microwave links between industrial havens（MESH）
information_points.content:
COM-MESH-MQV：Emergency telecom speed testing on the high-orbit backup satellite dish transceiver at the Central Polymer Process Bunker recorded a sustained satellite mesh downlink throughput of 100 Mbps during heavy weather simulation.
COM-MESH-2D7：For the North Perimeter Substation Safe Haven, emergency telecom testing on the high-orbit backup satellite dish transceiver demonstrated a sustained satellite mesh downlink throughput of 50 Mbps under simulated heavy weather conditions.
COM-MESH-X1P：Testing of the high-orbit backup satellite dish transceiver at the East Gate Administrative Hardened Complex showed a sustained satellite mesh downlink throughput of 50 Mbps under simulated heavy weather conditions.
